senses.gloss: m. (נָגַד; cmp. גּוֹד) a frame to spread clothes on.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 30a:4">B. Mets. 30ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 26b:4">Pes. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>אבידה לא ישטחנה ע״ג … מ׳ וכ׳</he> the finder must not spread a lost object in his charge over a bed or a frame for his own use.
